drawer.$description: Tokens of `drawer`: its panel, its backdrop and its slide.

inline-size.$description: Width of the panel, at most that of the page.

gap.$description: Space between the content and the close button.

close-button-padding.$description: Padding of the close button, around its icon.

backdrop-color.$description: Color of the backdrop over the page.

transition-duration.$description: Duration of the slide. Zero with reduced motion.
